title: FSM-Bench-20: Local LLM Benchmark for Deterministic FSM Generation
description: Reproducible benchmark of 20 natural-language requirement specifications for evaluating open-weight LLMs on guarded finite-state machine generation under local Ollama inference. Includes dataset, prompts, schema, evaluator, conservative guard-aware determinism (M0–M3), frozen 140-run campaign metrics (manifest 20260602T195520Z), cleaned outputs, and per-group diagnostics.
